skills: Up to 4 Ether hits. The 4th hit leaves 1 Fandom Power on the field.

Hold to charge up to 3 levels, then slam for massive Ether DMG. Absorbs nearby Fandom Power: each one adds a charge level and +10% Ether Anomaly Buildup to the next Perfect Pitch (max 2). With 2+ Fandom Power after her 4th Basic hit, No Ice kick, EX Special, Perfect Pitch 3rd hit, Quick Assist, Chain or Ultimate, hold (or tap after the last three) to spend 2 and jump straight to the 3rd hit. 40% DMG reduction while charging; invulnerable while attacking.
Quick dash dodge; doesn't reset the Basic Attack count.
Flying slash for Ether DMG; doesn't reset the Basic Attack count.
Powerful Ether slash; can flow straight into the 3rd Basic hit.
Powerful Ether slash; can flow straight into the 3rd Basic hit.
Parries an incoming attack for massive Daze.
A series of slashes for massive Ether DMG.
After the 4th Basic hit, Assist Follow-Up, Chain or Ultimate: a faster kick that leaves 1 Fandom Power on hit.
Kick plus sonic wave for Ether DMG; leaves 3 Fandom Power on hit.
Follow-up to Fall Into Delusion: a downward Ether strike that leaves 3 more Fandom Power on hit.
Series of attacks for massive Ether DMG; leaves 4 Fandom Power on activation.

Massive Ether shots, then Moment of Delusion for up to 15s: she gains 3 All-Out Cheering (each adds 2 charge levels to Perfect Pitch) and her Perfect Pitch 3rd hit is enhanced. Opens Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise, giving the squad +50 ATK for 30s. Leftover Cheering turns into 2 Fandom Power each on entering and leaving.

core.name: Innate Stage Presence
core.text: Anomaly Proficiency +{0}. When her Perfect Pitch 3rd hit lands on an enemy with any Attribute Anomaly, it triggers Abloom: an extra round of that Anomaly's DMG, equal to the rate below per 10 points of her initial Anomaly Mastery. +50% ratio against Stunned enemies.

ability.name: Collaborative Stage
ability.text: Whenever any Ether Veil is activated, 4 Fandom Power appear (once per 1s). Corruption applied by any squad member lasts 3s longer.

mindscapes: Her Basic, Special and EX Special ignore 10% Ether Anomaly Buildup RES. Abloom can CRIT: 25% Rate and 25% DMG, +0.5% Rate per initial Anomaly Mastery above 100.
Attacks and Abloom ignore 16% DEF, +8% more during Moment of Delusion.
Triggering Abloom gives 4 Energy and 70 Decibels (once per 10s).

Enters battle with 1,200 Decibels (once per 180s in Investigation Zones). Moment of Delusion no longer ends, and her enhanced Perfect Pitch and Ultimate deal +40% Ether DMG. In Delusion, an enemy entering an Anomaly gives 1 All-Out Cheering (once per 6s); extras past 3 become 2 Fandom Power.
